user.title: Connect to 511 Alberta
user.description: 511 Alberta's API asks for a free developer key (register at 511.alberta.ca, then request a key under Developers). Leave it blank to try without one. Optionally type a filter (e.g. 'Hwy 1 Canmore') to shorten the camera list on the next step.

camera.title: Choose a camera feed
camera.description: {count} feeds available. With the feed selector on, this is just the starting feed: you get a dropdown entity to switch feeds from a dashboard. Turn it off for a fixed camera.

error.key_required: 511 Alberta requires a developer key for this request.
error.no_match: No cameras matched the filter, so all cameras are shown.

abort.already_configured: That camera is already set up as a fixed feed.

data.weather_match_km: Max distance to a weather station (fallback)
